description: This source file defines enums, structs, and helper functions related to execution approvals, security policies, allowlist management, and event payloads within the OpenClaw project. It includes logic for loading, saving, and normalizing configuration files, as well as managing in-memory cache of skill binaries.

classes.name: SkillBinsCache
classes.description: An actor that manages a cache of skill binary names and paths with periodic refresh based on skills status reports.

classes.name: SkillBinTrustIndex
classes.description: A data structure holding the set of skill bin names and a mapping of names to resolved paths.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the exec-approvals.json configuration file.

methods.name: socketPath
methods.description: Returns the path of the socket used for exec approvals communication.

methods.name: normalizeIncoming
methods.description: Normalizes an ExecApprovalsFile object, especially the socket path/token and agent allowlists.

methods.name: readSnapshot
methods.description: Reads a snapshot of the current exec approvals configuration file, including its hash.

methods.name: redactForSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a redacted version of the ExecApprovalsFile for snapshot purposes, mainly masking sensitive info.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads the ExecApprovalsFile from disk, returning a default if failed.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves the given ExecApprovalsFile to disk.

methods.name: ensureFile
methods.description: Ensures that the configuration file exists and loads it, creating a default if necessary.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the effective ExecApprovalsResolved configuration for a given agent ID, loading and normalizing data.

methods.name: resolveReadOnly
methods.description: Loads the configuration in a read-only manner without writing, suitable for background threads.

methods.name: resolveFromFile
methods.description: Helper to resolve configuration data from a given ExecApprovalsFile object.

methods.name: resolveDefaults
methods.description: Returns the default resolved settings.

methods.name: saveDefaults
methods.description: Saves default exec approval settings.

methods.name: updateDefaults
methods.description: Updates default settings with a mutation closure.

methods.name: saveAgent
methods.description: Saves an agent’s configuration by agent ID.

methods.name: addAllowlistEntry
methods.description: Adds a new allowlist entry for an agent, validating the pattern.

methods.name: recordAllowlistUse
methods.description: Records usage of an allowlist pattern with associated command and path.

methods.name: updateAllowlist
methods.description: Replaces the allowlist for an agent with a new list, returning rejected entries.

methods.name: updateAgentSettings
methods.description: Updates mutable settings of an agent via a mutation closure.

methods.name: ensureSecureStateDirectory
methods.description: Creates the directory used for storing config files with appropriate permissions.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a secure random token string.

methods.name: hashRaw
methods.description: Computes SHA256 hash of a raw string.

methods.name: hashFile
methods.description: Computes SHA256 hash of an ExecApprovalsFile.

methods.name: expandPath
methods.description: Expands a path, handling ~ and relative paths.

methods.name: agentKey
methods.description: Derives a normalized key for agent dictionary based on agent ID.

methods.name: normalizedPattern
methods.description: Validates and normalizes allowlist patterns.

methods.name: migrateLegacyPattern
methods.description: Migrates legacy allowlist entries to the current format.

methods.name: normalizeAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Normalizes a list of allowlist entries, optionally dropping invalid ones.

methods.name: mergeAgents
methods.description: Merges two ExecApprovalsAgent entries, combining allowlists and settings.
